sections.heading: A token is one part of the decision

citations.text: OAuth 2.0 typically uses digitally signed security tokens in JWT (JSON Web Token) format that are passed in the Authenticate header of a request, making them harder to tamper with. OAuth 2.0 defines ways to authenticate different types of API clients: use client credentials when another service or application is consuming your API, outside of the context of a user use token exchange when another service or application needs to consume your API on behalf of a user – for example, the backend service of a web application needs to access your API with the same level of permissions as the user would receive use authorisation code , with the PKCE extension, when a user accesses your API – for example, through a web application

citations.title: Government Functional Standard - GovS 005: Digital (HTML)
citations.text: A detailed plan for government digital and data activity should set out owners, milestones, dependencies, risks and key performance indicators. Where AI is used, the plan should also define the intended benefits, data requirements, human oversight, assurance approach, model or tool ownership, monitoring arrangements and route for escalating risks. Plans should be agreed with relevant senior leaders and reviewed through governance and performance reporting. 4.3 Assurance Assurance provides confidence to senior leaders and stakeholders that work is controlled, proportionate and supports successful delivery of policy, strategy and objectives. Organisations should have a defined approach to assurance of government digital and data spend and activity. Assurance should be proportionate to risk, value and impact, integrated with the organisation’s overall assurance framework, and aligned to cross-government strategy, standards and expenditure controls. AI-enabled activity should be assured across its lifecycle, including use case selection, data quality, privacy, security, ethical risk, bias, transparency, human oversight, procurement, operational monitoring and retirement. Assurance should confirm that AI is used only where it is appropriate, lawful, secure and supported by the right skills and controls.

citations.locator: Public article: Set the right level of oversight
citations.text: The NCSC describes different levels of human oversight. Where unexpected activity could have significant consequences, it recommends human responsibility, monitoring and the ability to investigate and limit unintended activity. Additional judge agents also need independent evaluation.

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Playbook for the UK Government
citations.text: Auditability is the process of documenting every stage of the AI innovation life cycle – from data collection and base model training to implementation, system deployment, updating and retirement – in a way that’s accessible to relevant stakeholders and easily understood.
citations.rights: Selected Crown guidance under OGL v3.0; third-party examples and personal information excluded

citations.title: Artificial Intelligence Playbook for the UK Government
citations.text: You should understand, monitor and mitigate the risks that using AI tools can bring. Connect with the right assurance teams in your organisation early in the project life cycle for your AI solutions. You should have clearly documented review and escalation processes in place, and have an AI review board or programme-level board.

citations.title: Government Functional Standard GovS 007: Security
citations.text: 4.2 Assurance The purpose of assurance is to provide, through a systematic set of actions, confidence to senior leaders and stakeholders that work is controlled and supports secure and successful delivery of policy, strategy and objectives.
